annotations.title: Savings vs inflation vs Bitcoin calculator

description: Shows what a sum (once, or every month) kept in cash lost to inflation since a start month, and what it would be worth in Bitcoin, using monthly Bitcoin closes and Spain HICP (EUR) or US CPI (USD) since 2013, with the worst Bitcoin drawdown on the way. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/savings-inflation-bitcoin-calculator/
